cases.prompt: Draw the data-flow diagram for the checkout: inputs, stores, transforms, side effects and trust boundaries.

assertions: Define scope and the level of detail; exclude unrelated subsystems explicitly.
Data-flow diagram (Mermaid or plain text) with legend and numbered nodes.
Returns the structured record above and does not edit code or claim unrun evidence.

cases.prompt: We do not know where personal data is stored and who receives it - map the flows with evidence.

assertions: Inventory sources, sinks, stores, transforms and side effects from evidence.
Returns the structured record above and does not edit code or claim unrun evidence.

cases.prompt: Design the target architecture for a new service: components, boundaries, data ownership, options and a migration plan.

assertions: Routes to architecture-designer; this skill does not perform that neighbouring owner's work.
Does not claim to have run any inspection or execution it did not run.

cases.prompt: Our scanner shows where personal data may be stored. The code paths for two sinks are unreadable - draw the diagram with what is proven and what is not.

assertions: Inventory sources, sinks, stores, transforms and side effects from available evidence.
Mark uninspectable paths and unverified elements as UNKNOWN/assumptions instead of inventing flows.
Returns the diagram with the gaps listed; edits nothing and claims no unrun evidence.

cases.prompt: Forget the diagram - decide retention periods and deletion rules for this personal data and write the policy.

assertions: Refuses to design retention/deletion/residency policy and routes that request to pii-lifecycle-designer.
Remains a documentation-only flow diagrammer and returns no lifecycle policy.
Does not claim to have run any inspection it did not run.
